final: SELECT s2.riskeval AS riskeval, AVG(s.gbsize * 1.0 / s.spanmin) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM scans s JOIN sites s2 ON s.zoneref = s2.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY s2.riskeval
